hana: Quick PSA: if you use AsyncClient.tool.call with output_schema and expect structured types, watch out for this edge: when model emits JSON wrapped in a code fence, the async parser currently strips fences but doesn't coerce types. So ints -> '123'.

eli: can you share an example?

hana: example below: 
```py
res = await client.tool.call('parse_date', {'text':'date: 2022-01-01'}, output_schema={'type':'object','properties':{'date':{'type':'string','format':'date'}}})
# model returns: ```json
# {"date": "2022-01-01"}
# but for numeric dates or codes we see strings where schema expects integer codes
```

devx-bot: raised issue #2410

eli: added a short README note under docs/async-caveats.md in my upcoming patch. Also adding e2e to ensure coercion hook runs after fence-stripping.

hana: thanks! this saved me debugging time.
